title: Eligible Categories
policy_text: Eligible categories for reimbursement include airfare, lodging, meals, ground transportation, and approved business expenses like conferences.

title: Ineligible Categories
policy_text: Ineligible items that will not be reimbursed include alcohol, minibar, spa, gym, personal entertainment, in-room movies, personal shopping, gifts, traffic fines, penalties, late fees, and any personal/non-business expense.

title: Meals Daily Limit
policy_text: Meals are reimbursable up to a maximum of $75 per day.

title: Lodging Daily Limit
policy_text: Lodging is reimbursable up to a maximum of $200 per night.

title: Ground Transport Limit
policy_text: Ground transportation (e.g., taxis, rideshares, rental cars) is reimbursable up to $50 per day.

title: Airfare Class Limits
policy_text: Only economy class airfare is fully eligible for automatic approval. Business or first-class airfare always requires Manual Review.

title: Receipt Requirements
policy_text: A receipt is required for any individual expense item over $25. Furthermore, receipts are always required for airfare and lodging, regardless of the amount.

title: Missing Receipts
policy_text: If a required receipt is missing, the entire claim must be flagged for Manual Review.

title: Auto-Approval Threshold
policy_text: Claims with a total reimbursable amount less than or equal to $500 are eligible for Auto-Approval.

title: Manager Tier Threshold
policy_text: Claims with a total reimbursable amount strictly greater than $500 and less than or equal to $2,000 require Manager Tier approval (which can be handled by the normal review rules).

title: Manual Review Threshold
policy_text: Claims with a total reimbursable amount strictly greater than $2,000 must be flagged for Manual Review.

title: Submission Timeliness
policy_text: Claims must be submitted within 30 days of the trip end date. Claims submitted after 30 days require Manual Review.

title: Digital Receipt Formatting
policy_text: All employee bills must be submitted in PDF, JPG, or PNG formats. Physical receipts must be clearly scanned without motion blur. Illegible receipts will result in a Manual Review.
